import os
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f41a7dba.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # The topmost three adjacent cells define color tracks. Extend each track
    # vertically; perimeter markers of those colors draw horizontal tracks to it.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    top = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(row))
    cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(grid[top]) if v]
    colors = {grid[top][c]: c for c in cols}
    for color, c in colors.items():
        # Tracks run from the top pattern to any same-color perimeter endpoint.
        endpoints = [(r, j) for r in range(h) for j in range(w)
                     if grid[r][j] == color and (r, j) != (top, c)
                     and (r in (0, h-1) or j in (0, w-1))]
        stop = max([top] + [r for r, j in endpoints if j in (0, w-1)])
        for r in range(top, stop + 1):
            out[r][c] = color
        for r, j in endpoints:
            if j == 0:
                for x in range(j, c + 1): out[r][x] = color
            elif j == w-1:
                for x in range(c, w): out[r][x] = color
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
